faqs.a: US$250, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.
12 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.
The page promises payouts within a day, but the processing detail is thin. Confirm the exact timeline and any fees with support before funding anything.
The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

faqs.q: Does it offer a demo account?
faqs.a: Yes - a practice account is part of the package and runs alongside the live balance, which is the sensible first step before risking the US$250 minimum.

bottomLine: For a cautious newcomer, Aster Capitex can work: start on the demo, deposit the US$250 minimum and keep your own numbers.
The verdict holds at 4.7: research it, demo it, and if you fund it, fund the minimum. The platform earns a careful start, not blind trust.
